note: Raw spacing numbers (2 or more) left per area of scripts/check-design-tokens.js, written where a spacing goes instead of the spacing scale or a named inset from native/contracts/fixtures/design-tokens.json. The count must equal its area's budget: more is a new literal, fewer means the budget is stale; lower it with node scripts/check-design-tokens.js --write-budget, which never raises one. Exempt files are not counted; each says why, and a glob that matches no file fails. True geometry may sit in a // spacing-exempt-begin: <reason> … // spacing-exempt-end region.
